title: REVOLUTION MEN'S LEAGUE | WEEK 3 RECAP
content: Week 3 was a rollercoaster for the Revolution Men's Fall League. Asko Mostarlic's 25-point, 19-rebound monster night carried White past Red. Fab Anthony and Cory Chaplin traded 30-point salvos, but Green pulled away from Gray. Matt Spear's 30 kept Pink unbeaten, and Blue buried Black under a 60-point second half. Let's get into the action.

games.text: White set the tone early and jumped on Red from the start. Asko Mostarlic and Aid Semic ruled the paint, as Andy Bousono hounded every passing lane. Aaron West also drilled two threes to stretch the floor. Red could not find a rhythm, so White carried a 12-point cushion into the locker room. Halftime: White 36, Red 24. Red clawed back after the break. Logan Letourneau shouldered the load with 25 points and 15 rebounds, and Drew Pelkey chipped in 14 and five assists. Cam Perta kept firing and sank five triples, and Alex Philo cleaned the glass for 11 rebounds. Red won the half 39-37, but the hole was simply too deep to make a complete comeback. White held on for a 73-63 win.

performers.White: Asko Mostarlic — 25 pts, 19 reb, 5 ast, 1 blk, 1 stl; Aid Semic — 20 pts, 16 reb, 1 stl; Andy Bousono — 9 pts, 8 reb, 5 ast, 4 stl
performers.Red: Logan Letourneau — 25 pts, 15 reb, 4 ast, 1 blk, 1 stl; Cam Perta — 15 pts, 4 reb, 3 ast, 2 stl; Drew Pelkey — 14 pts, 7 reb, 5 ast, 1 stl

games.text: Green meant business from the opening tip. Fab Anthony sliced through the defense, while James Hare was faster than a jackrabbit on the break. Peter Lindholm did a solid job sweeping the boards. Green stacked up buckets and built a double-digit edge, but Cory Chaplin kept Gray within shouting distance with his long-range touch. Halftime: Green 41, Gray 32. Gray refused to wilt after the break. Cory Chaplin lit it up from deep, hitting seven threes on his way to 30 points. Jimmy Warden got into the lane and converted his free throw attempts, while showcasing a solid mid-range pull-up. Meanwhile, Jaren Jeffcoat dominated inside with 15 points and 12 boards. Unfortunately, they didn't have the stamina to continue closing the gap, so they ultimately fell short. Green earned a 79-65 victory.

performers.Green: Fab Anthony — 30 pts, 13 reb, 4 ast, 3 stl; James Hare — 16 pts, 4 reb, 2 ast, 1 blk, 1 stl; Peter Lindholm — 10 pts, 12 reb, 3 ast, 1 blk, 1 stl
performers.Gray: Cory Chaplin — 30 pts, 1 reb, 3 stl; Jimmy Warden — 16 pts, 7 reb, 2 ast, 1 stl; Jaren Jeffcoat — 15 pts, 12 reb, 3 ast, 1 blk, 1 stl

games.text: Orange struck fast. Carter Beeman buried four threes to get the Orange offense humming, as Kerry Lyons crashed the glass like a wrecking ball. Pink stumbled out of the gate, shooting poorly while Orange snagged a five-point lead. Halftime: Orange 30, Pink 25. Pink flipped the switch after intermission. Matt Spear took command, finishing with 30 points on 11-of-25 shooting, and Liam Walsh poured in 17, going 6-of-8 at the stripe. Paddy Monaghan swallowed nine rebounds and anchored a stingy defense with Spear. Orange mustered just 26 points in the half, while Pink poured in 41. As a result, Pink rolled to a 66-56 win and stayed perfect.

performers.Pink: Matt Spear — 30 pts, 6 reb, 1 ast, 2 stl; Liam Walsh — 17 pts, 7 reb, 3 ast, 2 stl; Paddy Monaghan — 9 reb, 2 ast
performers.Orange: Carter Beeman — 20 pts, 9 reb, 2 ast, 1 blk; Kerry Lyons — 12 pts, 14 reb, 2 ast, 1 stl; Kyle Haley — 12 pts, 5 reb, 2 ast, 1 stl

games.text: Blue got in front by the slimmest of margins. Will Ewald attacked the glass and rim, Eliezer Perez rained multiple threes, and Kyle Picard added steady scoring. Black hung tough behind Aiden Brown's range and Nick Lynn's inside work. One point separated the teams at the break. Halftime: Blue 27, Black 26. In the second half, Blue blew the game wide open. Black battled hard. Drew Fisher scored 18 and Aiden Brown matched him. Nick Lynn hauled in 16 rebounds and dished five assists. Still, Black scored only 36 in the half while Blue erupted for 60, a flood no defense could stop. Blue cruised to an 87-62 win.

performers.Blue: Will Ewald — 22 pts, 15 reb, 6 ast, 3 stl; Eliezer Perez — 17 pts, 8 reb, 1 ast, 2 stl; Kyle Picard — 13 pts, 7 reb, 1 ast, 2 stl
performers.Black: Aiden Brown — 18 pts, 7 reb, 2 ast, 1 stl; Drew Fisher — 18 pts, 7 reb, 3 ast, 1 blk; Nick Lynn — 12 pts, 16 reb, 5 ast, 1 blk, 1 stl
